headline: “What are you doing differently?” 5 reasons the answer is a 7-ingredient body cream
intro: From Real Skin Care. When someone asks what you changed, the answer can fit in one breath: coconut cream, seven ingredients, every night. Our Coconut Moisturizer starts from a 7-ingredient base, Pure Unscented is that base and nothing else, and one 4oz jar is $28.

hero.alt: Two coworkers talking by the office water cooler, from the Real Skin Care ad

reasons.title: Coconut cream. Seven ingredients. Every night.
reasons.body: Our cream starts from a 7-ingredient base: purified spring water plus six organic ingredients, virgin coconut oil, plant-based emulsifying wax, palm stearic, grapefruit seed extract, beeswax and red palm oil. Pure Unscented is that base alone. A popular drugstore coconut lotion lists 34 ingredients.

reasons.title: The kind of soft people notice.
reasons.body: Beeswax and coconut oil make it richer than a lotion, so it goes on like butter and works in without a slick film. It is made for the spots that get dry first: hands, heels and elbows.

reasons.title: A little goes a long way.
reasons.body: A small scoop covers a lot of skin. Used every night, one 4oz jar lasts about a month, which works out to under $1 a day.

reasons.title: Nothing added. Not even scent.
reasons.body: Pure Unscented has no fragrance, synthetic or natural. It is the 7-ingredient base and nothing else. No parabens and no synthetic fragrance in any of our creams.

reasons.title: Try it for 30 days.
reasons.body: If you don't love it, email us within 30 days and we will refund you. You don't have to send the jar back.

notes: Beeswax firms up in the cold. Warm a little between your fingers and it spreads easily.
Real coconut oil can separate a little in the jar. That is normal, and a quick stir brings it back together.

reviews.quote: I'm obsessed with all things Real Skin Care. This is THE moisturizer for Wisconsin winters for my whole family. It's long lasting and doesn't feel greasy. We use it all over and love it!
